_comment: TMDB cannot be searched by Finnish distributor title: it matches original, English and registered alternative titles only, and language=fi-FI does not widen the match (probed 2026-08-27). Key is enrich_tmdb.norm() of the title as the cinema publishes it. Value is either a TMDB movie id as a string, which skips the search entirely, or a replacement search string. run-enrich.log lists every title that found no id, which is what belongs here.
_comment2: Both spellings of one reissue need their own key: the key is the title as each chain publishes it, and BioRex says "Autot (re-release)" where Finnkino says "Autot (uudelleenjulkaisu)". "Autot" alone matched Cars 3 by popularity.
_comment3: Two cases the fi-FI search cannot settle. "Jonain päivänä" now finds a different Finnish-titled 2023 film before Leave One Day, and "Kummisetä osa II" misses TMDB's "Kummisetä II" by the word osa. Ids verified against /movie/{id}, never typed from memory.
_comment4: Kino Engel publishes Swedish-strand and Japanese titles the search can only match weakly, so no id is written and the row cannot merge across chains. "Minioner & monster" (BARNSÖNDAGAR, Swedish dub) is Kätyrit & Monsterit: verified, not assumed, by the cache holding the same id, the same trailer key and the same genre ids for both. "Kokuho - kabukin mestari" is 国宝, already cached with a rating from 100 votes. Both ids come from the weak match enrich itself found, so nothing here is typed from memory.

_comment_lucky_luke: Kino Regina, 2026-09-13. Regina publishes the original as "La ballade des Dalton"; TMDB 50166 registers it as "Lucky Luke: La Ballade des Dalton", so the exact-title rule refused the hit and the search kept it weak. Identity checked against the TMDB record: directors René Goscinny and Morris on both sides, 1978 on both, the Daltons' inheritance plot in both synopses, 84 against 82 minutes.
_comment_regina_weak: Kino Regina, 2026-09-13. Kuolemaantuomittu 687 (Dead Man Walking, Robbins 1995, 122 min both). Naisen kasvot: the weak candidate 4780 was De Palma's 1976 Obsession under its Finnish title and put the wrong poster on the row; 76848 is Molander's 1938 En kvinnas ansikte with Bergman, Svennberg and Henrikson, 104 min both. Palatsin hiljaisuus 44284 (Tlatli 1994, Hend Sabri; 127 against 124 min). Ringu 0: Bāsudei 9674 (Tsuruta 2000, Nakama, Tanabe, Asō, 99 min both).
_comment_markers: 2026-09-14. Two cases the cleaned search cannot settle. Laitilan Kino's "Matka Piemonteen" has no Finnish title registered on TMDB at all (site search: 0 films); the film is Alexandra-Therese Keining's "Resan till Piemonte", identified from the cinema's own film page by its director and by five of the six billed actors, every one of which the TMDB record carries. BioRex publishes "Avengers: Endgame Re-release (encore)", where the bare "Re-release" sits mid-title and the search landed weakly on 24428, The Avengers (2012): the trust gate withheld its metadata so nothing wrong shipped, but 50 showtimes went without a score while the same film matched 1769545 exactly at every other chain, on the same English synopsis. Ids read off /movie/{id}, never typed from memory.
